p = int(input())
k = int(input())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def fast_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

while True:
    try:
        p = int(input())
        k = int(input())
    except EOFError:
        break
    if k == 0:
        print(fast_pow(p, p - 1, MOD))
        continue
    if k == 1:
        print(fast_pow(p, p, MOD))
        continue
    seen = [False] * p
    count_cycles = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if seen[i]:
            continue
        j = i
        cycle_len = 0
        while not seen[j]:
            seen[j] = True
            j = (j * k) % p
            cycle_len += 1
        if fast_pow(k, cycle_len, p) == 1:
            count_cycles += 1
    print(fast_pow(p, count_cycles, MOD))
